name: dacta_M1_doc_chuoi_buffer
description: M1 - I/O Pipeline: tiep nhan ma phieu kho vao buffer stack 32 byte. v0: ingest_raw_line_v0 bo qua cap va dung strcpy, co the gay CWE-120/CWE-121 va tran dung 1 byte khi len=32 (tinh ca NUL). v1: ingest_raw_line_v1 kiem tra dst, raw_line, cap va len < cap truoc khi memcpy, sau do ghi NUL. Mo hinh Kripke la truong hop truu tuong voi cap=32.

requirements.text: Tu trang thai nhan chuoi, ton tai duong di den trang thai sao chep thanh cong: EF(copy_ok) (v0) / EF(copy_safe) (v1).
Moi duong di cuoi cung den trang thai ket thuc (thanh cong, tu choi, hoac loi duoc ghi nhan): AF(done). Day la tinh chat ket thuc, khong dong nghia rieng voi khong deadlock.
Khong co trang thai tran bo dem co the dat toi: AG(!violation). Du kien FALSE tren mo hinh v0 va TRUE tren mo hinh v1.
Khong ghi vuot 1 byte khi len=32 (can 33 byte ke ca NUL): AG(!off_by_one). Du kien FALSE tren v0 va TRUE tren v1.

M1-v0: strcpy khong kiem tra cap (CWE-12.description: Mo hinh v0 voi buffer stack 32 byte: len<=31 an toan; len=32 sao chep 33 byte (tinh NUL), vuot 1 byte; len>=33 vuot nhieu byte. Vi pham bo nho khong nhat thiet gay crash.

M1-v1: kiem tra len < cap truoc memcpy.description: Mo hinh v1 voi cap=32: len<=31 duoc sao chep va them NUL; len>=32 bi tu choi. Khop ingest_raw_line_v1 dung strlen, memcpy va dst[len]='\0'; khong dung strncpy.
Mo hinh v1 voi cap=32: len<=31 duoc sao chep va them NUL; len>=32 bi tu choi. Khop ingest_raw_line_v1 dung strlen, memcpy va dst[len]='\0'; khong dung strncpy.

functions.name: ingest_raw_line_v0 / ingest_raw_line_v1
functions.bug: buffer-overflow in v0 when len >= cap
functions.fix: v1 rejects len >= cap before memcpy

test_cases.title: Chuoi rong
test_cases.preconditions: dst la char buffer[32], cap=32, raw_line la chuoi C co NUL
steps: Tao chuoi dau vao dai 0 byte ASCII
Chay v0 voi ASan (neu moi truong ho tro) va luu log
Chay v1 voi cung input, ghi ma tra ve va kiem tra buffer
test_cases.expected_result: v0/v1: tra 0, buffer ket thuc NUL

test_cases.title: Chuoi dai 31 byte (bien hop le)
test_cases.preconditions: dst la char buffer[32], cap=32, raw_line la chuoi C co NUL
steps: Tao chuoi dau vao dai 31 byte ASCII
Chay v0 voi ASan (neu moi truong ho tro) va luu log
Chay v1 voi cung input, ghi ma tra ve va kiem tra buffer
test_cases.expected_result: v1: tra 31, khong ghi vuot buffer

test_cases.title: Chuoi dai 32 byte (tran 1 byte NUL trong v0)
test_cases.preconditions: dst la char buffer[32], cap=32, raw_line la chuoi C co NUL

test_cases.expected_result: v0: truy cap ghi ngoai bien (ASan co the phat hien); v1: tra -2

test_cases.expected_result: v0: truy cap ghi ngoai bien; v1: tra -2

steps: Tao chuoi dau vao dai 100 byte ASCII
Chay v0 voi ASan (neu moi truong ho tro) va luu log
Chay v1 voi cung input, ghi ma tra ve va kiem tra buffer
test_cases.expected_result: v0: truy cap ghi ngoai bien; v1: tra -2

test_cases.title: Con tro dst NULL
test_cases.expected_result: v1 tra -1; khong truy cap dst

model_assumptions: Mo hinh co dinh cap=32, tuong ung char buffer[32] o caller; ham C thuc te nhan cap va khong tu biet dung luong dst.
Chi tinh chuoi ASCII/byte co NUL ket thuc; strlen tren nguon khong NUL khong nam trong pham vi mo hinh.
Trang thai vi pham mo ta ghi ngoai bien, khong khang dinh crash hay ghi de stack frame.
Cac trang thai ket thuc co self-loop de quan he Kripke la total.
Mo hinh nay tap trung SC-01 sao chep buffer, chua bao gom SC-02 get_token_field CWE-125.
